content: Current stable versions (late 2025/2026): react-hook-form@7.66.x, zod@4.1.x, @hookform/resolvers@5.2.x. @hookform/resolvers bridges react-hook-form to zod so schema validation runs automatically on submit/blur. Standard pairing for type-safe admin forms — define a zod schema per admin form (e.g. limit adjustment, password reset) shared between validation and TS types.
